dialogue_storage: PicLex 关键词标签 learning.example/exampleChinese 保存 canonical A,B,A,B 4 话轮对白（A=学习者朗读评分，B=机器朗读不评分，角色标记不朗读）；角色说明仅保留在 cards.roles 元数据；cards.targets 各词 example_en/example_zh 仍为定稿摘录。
communication_goal: 说明修改的目的，并说明哪些行为保持不变。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers discuss a code change at a desk. The developer on the left points to a fully visible open laptop with screen and keyboard at center; the reviewer on the right listens and holds a pen. The laptop screen shows only sparse abstract short code-like lines, with no legible text, no red/green status, and no words. A small blank notebook is placed to the right, separate from the laptop. Friendly, clear explanation gestures.

coverage_review.scope: W042 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W042.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：同事围绕打开的笔记本讨论修改，屏幕使用抽象短线，无具体代码文字。重构、重复代码、函数与测试通过由对白说明，笔记本是唯一定位目标，不将抽象代码概念框在空白UI上。
